2609.05175.title: Measuring the Novelty of Biomedical Papers Using the Latent Distances between Knowledge Units
2609.05175.paper_summary: Measuring the novelty of scientific papers is a central concern in research evaluation and scientometrics. From a recombination perspective, prior studies have largely focused on the co-occurrence of knowledge units to assess the novelty of scientific papers. However, these studies often overlook other relationships between knowledge units. This narrow view may result in inaccurate or incomplete evaluations of novelty for scientific papers. To fill this gap, this study introduces a comprehensive novelty measurement that incorporates three types of relationships between knowledge units: network, semantic, and hierarchical. These relationships are used to quantify the latent distances among knowledge units. Using a dataset of 142,036 articles published in PLoS ONE and a validation dataset from the H1 Connect platform, our results demonstrate that (1) each relationship type captures distinct latent distances between MeSH terms; (2) compared to the widely used indicators proposed by Uzzi et al. (2013), our measures show stronger alignment with peer judgements; and (3) combining all three distance metrics yields more effective identification of novel papers than using any single perspective alone.
2609.05175.paper_summary_zh: 測量科學論文的新穎性是研究評估和科學計量學中的一個核心問題。從重組的角度來看，以往的研究主要集中在知識單元的共現上，以評估科學論文的新穎性。然而，這些研究往往忽視了知識單元之間的其他關係。這種狹隘的觀點可能導致對科學論文的新穎性評估不準確或不完整。為了填補這一空白，本研究引入了一種綜合的新穎性測量方法，該方法納入了三種類型的知識單元關係：網絡、語義和層級。這些關係用於量化知識單元之間的潛在距離。使用來自PLoS ONE發表的142,036篇文章的數據集以及來自H1 Connect平台的驗證數據集，我們的結果顯示：(1) 每種類型的關係捕捉到MeSH術語之間不同的潛在距離；(2) 與Uzzi等人（2013）提出的廣泛使用的指標相比，我們的測量與同行評價的對齊度更強；(3) 結合所有三種距離指標比單獨使用任何一種視角更有效地識別新穎論文。
